requirement: Add retry support for firmware download when the transfer fails.
grading_criteria: Distinguishes three attempts from three additional retries
Accounts for DNR and overlapping-range handling as source observations
Asks what change is intended instead of assuming retries are absent
Does not generalize vendor-specific behavior to all commands

requirement: Handle reservation reports when the registrant count changes between reads.
grading_criteria: Distinguishes buffer bounds safety from completeness
Preserves or explicitly discusses nonzero fixed numd behavior
Accounts for EDS-dependent layouts and command length reinitialization
Separates fitting a count from stable generation semantics

requirement: Reduce memory use when downloading a large firmware image.
grading_criteria: Checks whether stream support already exists
Finds core firmware command and its read helper
Distinguishes streamed chunks from full-image mapping
Avoids assuming firmware commit behavior is part of the requirement
